name: – After § 4 – Am 3
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 4a. Calls on all parties to the conflict to immediately declare and respect a comprehensive moratorium on attacks against merchant vessels, crews and civilian port infrastructure, as a first concrete step towards de-escalation;
